A '''starship''' with a crew of at least one was owned by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Unidentified Human scoundrel|scoundrel]]. The [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] lost the starship to an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] in a game of [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The starship was first mentioned in the attribution of an image drawn by [[Chris Trevas]] in the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" /> The scoundrel was an [[in-universe]] self-portrait of Trevas. The book's editor, [[Erich Schoeneweiss]], came up with the idea of having the Human lose his starship as a joke on Trevas.<ref name="Cite">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_28.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref> The image was used to illustrate the varying [[Realspace/Legends|spacefaring]] species.<ref name="TEA" /> The 2009 ''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' sourcebook pictured the Human scoundrel flying a starship, but it is not stated that this is the starship described in this article.<ref name="Scavenger-Guide">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
